name: Rspress
description: Rspress is a Rspack-based static site generator built on React and MDX that turns Markdown into fast static documentation pages.
notes: firstRelease from npm rspress creation (2022-10-26); the 2.x line is published as @rspress/core (the unscoped rspress package stays on 1.x). This setup pins @rspress/core 2.0.23 and replaces the default theme Layout (theme/index.tsx) with a bare one: no nav, sidebar, outline, search or footer; it renders only the post, and the index page lists all posts.
